info.name: Margyn — Login & Marketplace APIs
info.description:
Importable Postman v2.1 collection for https://margyn-backend.onrender.com. Contains 29 requests covering the 25 login and marketplace route/method combinations: customer OTP login, public catalog, cart, orders, profile/addresses, locations, site banners and health.

Setup: set phone in collection variables. Set origin in the active environment, or in collection variables if no environment is selected. It must exactly match FRONTEND_ORIGIN or ADMIN_ORIGIN configured on the backend. The backend URL itself is not automatically an approved Origin.

Login: send Request OTP, enter the delivered otpCode, then Verify OTP. The script captures challengeId and the returned otp (test mode) or developmentCode (local development). Keep Postman's cookie jar enabled: authentication uses the HttpOnly margyn_session cookie, not a bearer token.

Shopping: GET products captures an available catalogProductId, productSize and cartonQuantity; add a cart line, then GET cart to obtain cartTotal. A saved address can be created through Profile. POST orders requires a signed-in user and the exact latest expectedTotal. It creates an unpaid marketplace order request.

Scripts update COLLECTION variables, so the optional environment contains only baseUrl and origin. Select requests individually as needed. Saved responses are illustrative source-derived examples, not captured production data; IDs, timestamps, prices and content will differ. Image redirects/binary responses are described where applicable.

variable.description: Backend base URL without a trailing slash.
Set to an exact URL allowed by the deployed backend's FRONTEND_ORIGIN or ADMIN_ORIGIN; this is usually your storefront/admin URL, not the backend URL.
Your customer mobile number; set before requesting OTP.
Delivered OTP, or developmentCode only when the server is in development OTP mode.
Captured from the selected product sizes.
Minimum carton order captured from the selected product. Edit as needed.

exec: // Session and guest-cart cookies are retained by Postman automatically.
let d; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (_) {}
const save = (k,v) => { if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set(k, String(v)); };

request.description:
Creates an OTP challenge. The post-response script saves challengeId. Set otpCode from the delivered SMS; only development mode returns developmentCode. Admin login requires a previously granted administrator number.

Access: public or endpoint-specific authentication.

Temporary deployed testing: set OTP_PROVIDER=test in Render and redeploy this backend to return otp in this response. Submit it as code to verify-otp. No SMS is sent in test mode.
